With --gamma-result, gamma.complete is the exact external precomputed bank, never copied, refilled or recomputed. Raw complex observables, preparation/fermion defects and differences from the previous actual provider are serialized unchanged.
continuation_api.gamma_reuse: Optional GammaResult is authenticated before any electronic Native, including actual complete-bank/slot/native receipts, identical M2/G1/preparation/N64/order/beta/admitted binary and all three Pi NPY shape/dtype/bytes/SHA. Only Pi file paths may differ after full canonical composition; no relabeling, tolerance or changed-input acceptance. Original R/< solve payload digests are checked. Local Gamma bank is not opened or allocated when supplied. Omitting it retains fresh-Gamma committed-slot/refused-staging behavior.
continuation_api.provenance: Invocation/provider/result/handoff identify actual precomputed Gamma origin and complete binding. Sources are the union of full electronic inputs and actual Gamma/result/bank/upstream bindings, preserving their paths.
continuation_api.costs: Per-Native-case recorded wall/CPU/maxRSS and per-attempt owner wall/maxRSS are persisted separately. Cumulative recorded costs include retained failed Native receipts and resumed attempts. Interrupted unknown costs are explicit; overlapping owner/Native wall measures are not summed. With Gamma reuse, local Native counts include only new electronic calls (up to128, never a claim of129); precomputed Gamma original costs and receipts are retained separately in costs.precomputed_gamma.original_accounting. Upstream G1/M2/kernel and prior recovery costs remain bound ancestry, not silently counted zero or rebilled.
